wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: The way in. One sideways question picks a world to open; every world is listed under it for anyone who would rather choose.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: What the site is trying to work out about you, every way it has of asking, and the fourteen answers it can arrive at. Ask again here, or make it forget you.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: This page: every page of the site with a line on what it is.

offSky.name: the quiet room
offSky.what: A breath to follow, a dimmer that stays where you leave it, and nothing that needs doing.

offSky.name: the kinetic floor
offSky.what: Heavy blocks to fling with a pointer or the arrow keys, and a gravity you can turn over.

offSky.name: the machine shop
offSky.what: All 256 elementary cellular automata, one rule at a time, with the eight bits of the rule printed underneath.

offSky.name: loam
offSky.what: A cutaway of soil. Plant something, water it, and watch the roots find their way round the stones.

offSky.name: the word kiln
offSky.what: Put a word in the fire and a coinage comes out, with a definition and a citation that never existed.

offSky.name: the apocrypha desk
offSky.what: A catalogue of objects that were never real, dealt one at a time, with a drawer you keep.

underSky.name: the wish constellation
underSky.what: Place small thoughts as stars and drag them into a shape. The sky you make here is the one every other world under the sky reads.

underSky.name: the diary
underSky.what: Your stars replayed as a logbook, with entries written from where they sit.

underSky.name: the echo chamber
underSky.what: Your stars as drifting echoes you can pulse and listen to.

underSky.name: the weather lab
underSky.what: Your stars as pressure systems, with a forecast you can print.

underSky.name: the orbital weaver
underSky.what: Your stars mirrored into a slow mandala you can ripple.

underSky.name: the archive oracle
underSky.what: Spin your stars through a rune wheel, collect small omens, and forge a sigil to keep.

underSky.name: the lantern ritual
underSky.what: Your stars as lanterns you can kindle one at a time, and a reading pulled from the sky.

underSky.name: the terrarium
underSky.what: Your stars as plants in a glasshouse, with their own small weather.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Served for any address this site does not have. The observatory on it still works.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: The same list, machine-readable, with relative locations so it holds under any sub-path.
